title: resend_http input
description: Input schema for the resend_http tool (RFC-001 N8 typed HTTP resend).

flow_id.description: Recorded HTTP stream id. When set, omitted fields are inherited from the original send.

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, ...). Required when flow_id is empty.

scheme.description: URL scheme. Required when flow_id is empty.

authority.description: Host header / :authority value. Required when flow_id is empty.

path.description: Request path including the leading slash. Required when flow_id is empty.

raw_query.description: Raw query string without the leading '?'.

headers.description: Ordered header list; preserves wire case, order and duplicates.

body_encoding.description: Encoding of the body field. Default text.

body_set.description: Set to true to override the body to empty; otherwise omitting body inherits the original (when flow_id is set).

body_patches.description: Body modifications applied on top of any body replacement.

regex.description: Regex pattern for text-based body patching.

encoding.description: Optional codec chain applied to the patch value.

override_host.description: Redirect the dial target (host:port) while preserving the request's Host/:authority.

follow_redirects.description: Unsupported. Setting true returns an explicit error.

tls_fingerprint.description: Informational v1; per-call selection deferred. Server uses its configured fingerprint.

tag.description: Tag stored on the new flow's Tags map.
